title: 第1章 桃花山刘氏第2章 初次猎妖
content_zh:
第1章桃山刘氏
在苍茫无际的宇宙修仙界中，一颗名为玄黄星的修仙星球上，有一座神华大陆，大陆之上王国众多，宗派林立。
在大陆东南，有一个名为大唐王朝的凡人国度。
在大唐王朝中南道东华州云平县境内，有一座名为桃山的一阶上品灵山。
占据此山的是一支名为桃山刘氏的炼气修仙家族。
桃山刘氏家族是青云宗的外门弟子刘武在突破筑基无望后，向宗门申请拓荒建立的。
当年，刘武和同门师兄弟在青云山脉外围历练时，无意中发现了这座一阶灵山。
整个桃山的山域面积并不大，只有五十多里，最高的主峰桃峰却高有千丈，山势奇伟俊秀，灵泉众多，灵气充沛，有一条一阶上品灵脉。
在一阶灵脉和灵泉的滋养之下，山上景色秀美，草木繁茂，生长着不少珍贵的一阶灵植，有灵药、灵木、灵果，最珍贵的是二十四株一阶碧玉灵桃树。
碧玉灵桃是一种很珍贵的灵果，能够增进炼气修士的法力。
桃山脚下，则是一处方圆三十里大小的湖泊，山上的泉水最终流入这个小湖，湖中生长着三十六株一阶青玉莲，还有银刀鱼、金红鲤等多种一阶灵鱼。
湖边的土地肥沃，可以开辟成灵田用来种植灵米、灵药。
而且桃山周边数百里范围内，都是矮山丘陵谷地，也没有可供二阶妖兽盘踞的二阶灵脉，因此，非常适合在此建立家族。
于是联络了几个宗门好友，一起杀死了占据这座的黑熊妖兽，占据此山，取名桃山。
并向宗门申请了拓荒令，在此娶妻生子，开枝散叶，建立修仙家族。
大唐历3165年三月的一天清晨，在桃山主峰山腰的一座大院内，一个身穿青衣的英俊少年，正在练功房内打坐修炼。
只见他盘坐在一个黄色蒲团之上，双目微闭，五心朝天，正在运功吐纳呼吸，空气中的红、绿、蓝三色灵气随着一呼一吸被其慢慢吸入体内。
突然，这名少年睁开了微闭的双眼，一道寒芒闪现！
随着清吟声响起，周围的灵气如乳燕归巢般涌入体内！
这名少年名叫刘长旭，今年十六岁，炼气五层，水、木、火三灵根资质，是桃山刘氏第六代子弟，长字辈老七。

“看来要突破炼气六层，还需要一段时间呀！今天是我首次参加入山猎杀妖兽活动的日子，得赶快吃饭了！”刘长旭自言自语道：
随即，刘长旭收功站起身形，离开练功房，快步走到家中餐厅。
发现父亲刘世昊、母亲林玉莲、两位姨娘以及弟弟妹妹们均已坐好，准备开饭了。
宽大的青玉餐桌上，摆满了用白玉餐盘盛放的珍馐美味，灵果佳酿。
在餐桌主位上，端坐着一位英俊帅气的中年男人，身穿青色长衫，国字脸，面白如玉，双目似电，再加上潇洒缥缈的气质，颇为引人注目。
这位中年男人就是刘长旭的亲生父亲刘世昊。
刘世昊今年四十五岁，已是炼气九层修为，在家族世字辈排行第五，家族七长老，木、火、土三灵根，一阶上品灵植师和炼丹师，刘氏家族最有希望筑基的人，现有妻妾三人。
坐在刘世昊左边的正是刘长旭的亲生母亲林玉莲，也是刘世昊的正妻。
今年38岁，身穿青色长裙，肤如凝脂、面若桃，很是端庄秀丽，四灵根，炼气7层修为，她是刘氏家族八长老，一阶中品灵符师和灵膳师，出身于炼气家族林家。
林玉莲生有一子一女，刘长旭是长子，次女刘长雪，长字辈排十九，今年10岁，四灵根炼气二层。
二夫人梁玉娘，来自炼气家族梁家，五灵根资质，炼气四层。今年30岁，长得窈窕妩媚，清丽动人，共生育一子一女。
女儿刘长馨年仅13岁，长字辈排十五，五灵根资质，炼气二层修为。
儿子刘胜，今年11岁，生得俊秀，可惜的是没有灵根，按照家族规矩，十六岁后要到山下的桃镇居住生活。
三夫人史文霞，今年26岁，四灵根，炼气四层修为，散修出身，身材火辣，充满野性之美。生一女刘灵，今年4岁，长得古灵精怪，非常可爱，是全家的开心果。
刘长旭赶忙上前行礼道：“见过父亲、母亲、两位姨娘！”
刘世昊见到儿子到来，心里很是欣慰，这个儿子年仅十六岁就已经是炼气五层巅峰了，将来筑基的希望很大，没有辜负自己的期望。
于是，微笑着说道：“旭儿，你母亲知道你第一次进山猎妖，怕你进山吃不好，特地早早的为伱做了一桌丰盛的早饭，我们也都跟着沾光了。”
父亲的这句话，让刘长旭对母亲及家人充满感激，看着这一桌丰盛的饭菜，估计母亲还有姨娘们昨晚一定都没有休息好。
content_en:
Chapter 1 Momoyama Liu Family
In the boundless world of immortality in the universe, on a planet of immortality called Xuanhuang Star, there is a Shenhua Continent. There are many kingdoms and sects on the continent.
In the southeast of the mainland, there was a mortal country called the Tang Dynasty.
In Yunping County, Donghua Prefecture, Central South Road of the Tang Dynasty, there is a first-level high-grade spiritual mountain called Taoshan.
Occupying this mountain is a Qi-refining and immortal-cultivating family called the Taoshan Liu family.
The Taoshan Liu family was founded by Liu Wu, an outer disciple of the Qingyun Sect, who applied to the sect to open up land after he had no hope of building a foundation.
Back then, when Liu Wu and his fellow disciples were training outside the Qingyun Mountains, they accidentally discovered this first-order spiritual mountain.
The entire Taoshan mountain area is not large, only more than fifty miles, but the highest main peak, Taofeng, is thousands of feet high. The mountains are majestic and beautiful, with many spiritual springs, abundant spiritual energy, and a first-level high-grade spiritual vein.
Under the nourishment of first-order spiritual veins and spiritual springs, the mountain has beautiful scenery and luxuriant vegetation. Many precious first-order spiritual plants grow there, including elixirs, spiritual trees, and spiritual fruits. The most precious ones are twenty-four first-order jasper spiritual peach trees.
Jasper Spirit Peach is a very precious spiritual fruit that can increase the magic power of Qi Refining monks.
At the foot of Peach Mountain, there is a lake with a radius of thirty miles. The spring water from the mountain eventually flows into this small lake. In the lake, there are thirty-six first-order jade lotuses, as well as various first-order spiritual fish such as silver saury, golden red carp, etc.
The land around the lake is fertile and can be opened into spiritual fields to grow spiritual rice and elixirs.
Moreover, within hundreds of miles around Taoshan, there are low hills, hills and valleys, and there are no second-level spiritual veins for second-level monsters to occupy. Therefore, it is very suitable to establish a family here.
So he contacted several sect friends, and together they killed the black bear monster occupying this mountain, took over the mountain, and named it Taoshan.
He also applied for a pioneering order from the sect, married a wife and had children here, spread his branches and established a family of immortal cultivators.
One early morning in March 3165 of the Tang Dynasty, in a compound on the mountainside of the main peak of Taoshan, a handsome young man in Tsing Yi was meditating in the practice room.
I saw him sitting cross-legged on a yellow futon, his eyes slightly closed, his five hearts facing the sky, and he was exercising his energy and breathing. The red, green, and blue spiritual energy in the air was slowly inhaled into his body with each breath.
Suddenly, the young man opened his slightly closed eyes, and a cold light flashed!
As the clear chant sounded, the surrounding spiritual energy poured into the body like a baby swallow returning to its nest!
This young man's name is Liu Changxu. He is sixteen years old this year. He has the fifth level of Qi refining and the three spiritual roots of water, wood and fire. He is the sixth generation descendant of the Taoshan Liu family and the seventh in line.
"It seems that it will take some time to break through the sixth level of Qi refining! Today is my first time to participate in the activity of hunting monsters in the mountains, so I have to eat quickly!" Liu Changxu said to himself:
Immediately, Liu Changxu stopped his exercise, stood up, left the practice room, and walked quickly to the restaurant at home.
I found that my father Liu Shihao, my mother Lin Yulian, my two aunts, and my younger brothers and sisters were all seated and ready to eat.
The large sapphire dining table is filled with delicacies, spiritual fruits and fine wines served on white jade plates.
At the main seat of the dining table, there sat a handsome middle-aged man, wearing a blue gown, with a face as white as jade and eyes as bright as lightning. Coupled with his chic and ethereal temperament, he was quite eye-catching.
This middle-aged man is Liu Changxu’s biological father Liu Shihao.
Liu Shihao is forty-five years old this year. He is already at the ninth level of Qi Refining. He is ranked fifth in the family. He is the seventh elder of the family. He has the three spiritual roots of wood, fire and earth. He is a first-class spiritual planter and alchemist. He is the most promising person in the Liu family to build a foundation. He currently has three wives and concubines.
Sitting on the left side of Liu Shihao is Liu Changxu's biological mother Lin Yulian, who is also Liu Shihao's first wife.
She is 38 years old this year. She is wearing a long green dress. She has a skin like cream and a face like a peach. She is very dignified and beautiful. She has four spiritual roots and a seventh-level Qi refining level. She is the eighth elder of the Liu family and a first-level mid-level spirit.The Talisman Master and Lingshan Master were born in the Lin family, a Qi refining family.
Lin Yulian has a son and a daughter, Liu Changxu is the eldest son, and Liu Changxue, the second daughter, is the 19th eldest son. She is 10 years old this year and has the second level of Four Spiritual Root Qi Refining.
The second wife, Liang Yuniang, comes from the Liang family, a Qi refining family. She has five spiritual roots and is at the fourth level of Qi refining. She is 30 years old this year. She is slim, charming, and beautiful. She has a son and a daughter.
Daughter Liu Changxin is only 13 years old, ranked fifteenth in the eldest generation, possesses five spiritual roots and is at the second level of Qi refining.
His son Liu Sheng, 11 years old this year, is handsome, but unfortunately he has no spiritual roots. According to family rules, he has to live in Taozhen down the mountain after he turns 16.
The third wife, Shi Wenxia, ​​is 26 years old this year. She has four spiritual roots and a fourth level of Qi refining. She is a casual cultivator. She has a hot figure and is full of wild beauty. She gave birth to a daughter, Liu Ling, who is 4 years old this year. She is quirky and very cute. She is the joy of the whole family.
Liu Changxu hurriedly stepped forward and saluted: "I have met my father, mother, and two aunts!"
When Liu Shihao saw his son arriving, he was very pleased. This son was already at the peak of the fifth level of Qi Refining at the age of sixteen. He had great hope of building a foundation in the future and he lived up to his expectations.
So, she said with a smile: "Xu'er, your mother knew that it was your first time to go into the mountains to hunt monsters. She was afraid that you would not be able to eat well when you went into the mountains, so she specially cooked a sumptuous breakfast for you early, and we all benefited from it."
His father's words made Liu Changxu feel grateful to his mother and family. Looking at this sumptuous meal, he guessed that his mother and aunts must not have had a good rest last night.
